messages:
maya: quick proposal — want feedback on an "adaptive pin" policy for the catalog. goal: reduce long-lived pins while protecting high-risk customers. TL;DR: dynamic pin windows based on usage + safety budget + automated comms. thoughts? :thinking_face:
devon: sounds promising. can you sketch the signals we’d use to shorten vs extend a pin window?
maya: sure — primary signals: 1) per-customer error/regression rate on canary prompts, 2) request volume/plateau, 3) observed perf delta vs baseline (latency/cost), 4) eval score drift on held prompts. short note: prefer conservative thresholds initially.
arjun: how does this interact with committed Dedicated customers? they need predictable behavior — any automatic unpinning would need an opt-out and notification SLA.
maya: agreed. plan: default adaptive for public hosted customers; opt-in adaptive for Dedicated; enterprise opt-out flag enforced via account config. will add explicit 30d notice for any forced migration.
lena: what about rollback/backstop? we should auto-repin to last-known-good if eval/regression crosses X. also add canary window + staged rollout.
samir: +1. also need a "risk budget" metric per model: how many migrations allowed in a quarter before we stop auto-migrations. keeps churn in check.
devon: propose numeric defaults for discussion: canary 1% traffic for 48h, eval drift threshold 3% BLEU/ROUGE-ish or equivalent, perf delta >15% latency or 20% cost triggers hold.
maya: putting a minimal config example for the policy (pseudoconfig):
```
{
  "adaptive_pin": true,
  "canary_pct": 1,
  "canary_duration_hours": 48,
  "eval_drift_threshold_pct": 3,
  "perf_delta_latency_pct": 15,
  "rollback_on_regression": true,
  "risk_budget_quarter": 2
}
```
lena: good to include observability hooks — eval-set ids, story ids, and a changelog link in customer emails.
samir: ops ask: what automation surface? we can 1) create rollout job + alert on fail, 2) create a customer-facing ticket when auto-migration scheduled, 3) flag for SE to review high-value customers.
maya: yes — action items:
- maya: draft full policy doc + thresholds and examples (ETA Tue)
- devon: translate thresholds into monitoring checks and alert playbook (ETA Wed)
- lena: draft customer communication templates + FAQ (ETA Wed)
- samir: design rollout automation + risk-budget enforcement in the rollout engine (ETA Fri)
- arjun: list Dedicated accounts to exclude/opt-in and confirm SLA language (ETA Thu)
I’ll post in #customer-success when doc live.
deploy-bot: docs: model-catalog/adaptive-pin-policy.md created by maya at 2026-11-02T14:12:03Z
arjun: quick customer note: two enterprise accounts asked for exception logic last week — will send specifics to maya.
maya: thanks — will include exceptions table. if no objections I’ll lock the draft and run a mini canary on staging next week. :thumbsup:
devon: no objections from infra. we should get eng-qa to run eval harness against canary models.
lena: customer comms reviewed — small edits then 👍
samir: will start the rollout engine ticket and attach a small migration playbook.
maya: great, closing this thread — will ping when draft is live. thanks all!
